The desk pet grows up: it moves out of the editor sidebar onto the board, and every tablet at the table can take care of it.

## Highlights

- **The pet is a tile now.** Add "Zwierzak" from the action catalog - it lands as a 2x2 tile that renders the animal right on the board (sprite, four mini stat bars, R.I.P. screen). The old sidebar panel is gone. Add several pet tiles if you like: they all show the same animal, on this machine and everywhere else.
- **Tablets join the care rota.** On the Android client the pet tile draws the species natively (blob, cat, frog, chick, axolotl) with its mood face, sleep Zzz and poos. Gestures work like the tools: tap feeds, double-tap plays, long-press cleans - or lays a new egg when the pet has died.
- **One shared pet.** The state moved from per-machine localStorage to the server (`pulpitApp/pet.json`): the editor simulates it and pushes snapshots, tablets render what they receive, and a care tap from any surface round-trips back to the simulation. Stock Deckboard clients see the pet as a plain text line ("Kot · Zadowolone").
- **Sleep takes care of itself.** The sleep toggle and the petting button are gone: rest drains, and when it hits bottom the pet curls up and naps until fully rested. Three gestures, no menu.
- **Old pets survive the move.** The first launch after updating adopts the pet from the previous version - species, age, stats, family records and all.

## Notes

- Feeding wakes the pet, and events (hatch, grow-up, poo, sleep, death) reach tablets at once; the routine stat drain updates them about every 15 seconds.
- A headless server relays the pet but has no simulator: with only a server running, the pet pauses - the same mercy closing the app gets.

## Install

- **Desktop**: update in-app or grab `pulpit-desktop-1.10.0.exe` below - the updater feed is pointing here.
- **Android**: install `pulpit-1.10.0.apk` over the previous version.
